title: Yo invito
desc: Reaching for your share and getting it badly wrong
setting: There are four empty bottles on the table and you have just put your hand in your pocket.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.en: What are you doing? Put that money away, man.

options.en: Ideay, at least let me chip in.
options.feedback: You are still splitting the bill. It is friendly, and it is not how a round works here.

options.es: Está bien. Entonces la otra la pago yo.
options.en: All right. Then the next one is on me.
options.feedback: That is the answer. You do not divide a bill here, you take the next one, and everybody keeps count without a word.
Said out loud at a table of friends, that is close to an insult. It tells them tonight was a transaction.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.en: That is it. Today it is on me. Another Toña?

options.es: Dale pues, una más y ya.
options.en: Go on then, one more and that is it.
options.feedback: Accept and set your own limit in the same sentence. Nobody minds when you stop, only how you stop.
The bottle is coming. Saying how many more you want is the part that saves you at midnight.

options.en: No, I do not want anything else.
options.feedback: Cutting it off flat while he is buying reads as leaving. Una más y ya does the same job warmly.

options.es: ¡Salud! Por los amigos y por Nicaragua.
options.en: Cheers! To friends and to Nicaragua.
options.feedback: Answer a toast with a toast and add one thing. That is the whole form and it never fails at this table.
Correct. A second clause costs nothing and it is what everybody else adds.
He raised a bottle, not a favour. Thanking a toast leaves his arm in the air.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: ¿Y vos por qué querías pagar la mitad?
steps.en: And why did you want to pay half?

options.es: Porque en mi país se hace así. Ya aprendí.
options.en: Because that is how it is done where I am from. I have learned now.
options.feedback: Name the difference, say you have got it, move on. That answer ends the subject and keeps the evening.
True enough. He asked because he was curious about where you come from, not to tell you off.

options.es: Porque no me gusta deber nada.
options.en: Because I do not like owing anybody anything.
options.feedback: Here you are supposed to owe people. A favour that is never repaid is what a friendship is made of.
